Welcome to Grassway Organics

Nestled in the rolling countryside of East Troy, WI, our family-run organic farm is rooted in the belief that sunshine, fresh air, and nutrient-rich soil create happy animals and vibrant food. All of our animals live on and graze regenerative pastures and are fed only organic feeds.

​​

This translates into healthy food that nourishes you. Food is health, and food can be medicine.

​​

You can shop our on-farm store for pasture-raised meats, eggs, dry goods, and local favorites like honey and cheese. You can also order through our webstore for convenient home delivery of our meats and eggs. From May through September, join us for Pizza on the Farm—our seasonal event with wood-fired pizza, live music, and room to roam.

​​

Almost everything we offer is pasture raised and local, grown or raised with care to nourish you and your family.

About

Chaz and Megan Self followed a dream and took over Grassway Organics on March 21st, 2016. Neither Chaz nor Megan grew up on a farm, but they both have a passion for farming and sustainable agriculture. Raising their three young sons — Otik, Oscoda, and Xasion —on a farm was the only option they considered for raising a family.
With no concrete background of "that's how grandpa did it" farming, the couple pledged from the start that Organic and grazing was the only way they would farm. This kind of farming is called "managed rotational grazing." It involves getting the cows out of the barn and onto the green pastures in the fresh air and sunshine.

We milk about 40 Jersey cows and graze all their calves on 210 acres of pasture. We focus on bloodlines and milk only A2/A2 cows. Because we value diversity, we also pasture-raise chickens for eggs and meat, dairy steers for meat,  as well as Thanksgiving Turkeys. None of our animals have had any injections.
 

The power and benefits of fresh air, sunshine, and exercise cannot be emphasized enough. Healthy, happy animals are our goal to ultimately produce milk, cheese, and meats that are natural and clean.

 

We would be honored to be your Farmers.

 

-The Self Family

DAIRY AND BEEF

All our cattle graze on an intense rotational system. All 390 acres are boarded with high tensile wire with automatic waters in all paddocks.

​

We move our milking cows four times a day and our beef animals twice.

All our cows raise their own babies for three months.
Regenerative agriculture is the only sustainable way to raise animals in a healthy lifestyle that also builds a healthy ecosystem in the soil.

We will never feed grain! All of our cows are 100% grass-fed. We put up almost all of our own balage and hay for the wintertime. We have two large sheds that allow us to keep the cows on a deep-bedded pack. This allows us to compost for two years with a static air ration system.

CHICKEN & EGGS

First, we'll start off with our hard-working ladies. Our 600 laying hens are always hard at work on pasture at our farm.

We rotate our chickens three days behind our milking cows. This allows ample time for bugs and grubs to grow in the fields, providing food for the chickens and creating a sustainable management system for manure. This is the true meaning of 'free-range and pasture-raised.' All our coops are mobile and moved every day. The eggs are collected from outside of the coop.

All of our meat chickens spend three weeks in a warm mobile brooder before being put on pasture. We have a perimeter electric poultry fence that keeps the ground predators at bay and our trusty guard dogs are always with them. We raise them truly free-range with a mobile shade structure that protects them from the elements.

PASTURED PORK

We offer some of the healthiest pork we’ve ever found Raised at Golden Bear Farm out of Kiel, WI— Golden Bear Farm never feeds CORN, SOY, GMO’s, antibiotics, hormones or any processed foods. Their pork is processed by Beck’s Meats who uses only natural ingredients (no gluten, either) in our sausages, and smokes our bacon and hams using no nitrates (hence, the label “uncured”), no nitrites, no MSG and no funny business.

​

Steve, the head farmer, has spent years researching nutrition to ensure their pigs have a nutrient dense diet on which they thrive thereby ensuring that WE thrive. In the summertime, the pigs rotationally graze on lush pastures. In the fall, they have their own salad bar. They plant a garden just for them that contains a variety of vegetables, like squashes, melons, and turnips. In the winter, we feed them apples, pumpkins, other squashes along with barley, field peas and hay.

​

Golden Bears  pigs live in a very low-stress environment with ample space even in the winter. We never dock their tails or ring their noses. Piglets stay with their siblings until they are full grown. You should see how playful they are !

THANKSGIVING TURKEYS

We also do pasture-raised Turkeys for Thanksgiving. Our turkeys spend their first three weeks getting used to freedom in a warm mobile brooder. They then hit the pasture running with a mobile roost that is moved every day. They have electric poultry netting around the perimeter and are always protected by our guard dog.

Frequently Asked Questions 

I'm interested in ordering Bonafide Owner's product. How do I do that?

Our Bonafide owners have access to unpasteurized product, from A2/A2 100% Grass-Fed Jersey cows. 

Becoming a Bonafide owner with a farm is a legal requirement in the state of Wisconsin to receive a distribution of milk for the dairy herd managed by the legal entity you become an owner of, a bonafide owner. We are able to take on new bonafide owners as our herd grows, which happens a couple of times a year. 

You only need to pay an initial capitalization fee of $250 to purchase a Bonafide ownership interest in Grassway Organics, LLC. This only applies to milk distribution, all other items are purchasable products available for non-owners without a capitalization fee. 

New Bonafide Owner Memberships are currently CLOSED!!

Sign up below to be notified next time they re-open:

Notification List Form

Bonafide Owner Memberships are $10 a year and renew yearly. We apply the fee to your first order. Then to the first order of the following year, and so on.

Note: Demand for unpasteurized product is very high while our herd grows slowly but surely. Memberships are first come first served and can close again quickly once opened.

We have two calving seasons per year, in that time unpasturized product supply will be much lower then usual and limits will be in place.

I placed an order. What now?

You should receive an e-mail order confirmation right away. We pack orders the day before delivery, that is when your card will get charged and you will receive a final receipt e-mail. Note: Your final total will most likely by slightly different from the initial order, as our frozen meats can vary a bit in size. 

Delivery

Owners:

The delivery fee is $2 per order, in addition to payment of monthly expenses of the operating expenses of Grassway Organics LLC. 

Non-Owners:

The delivery fee is $2 per order.

I'm trying to place an order but it won't let me.

We do not home deliver unpasteurized product or eggs, you would need to change your pick-up option for the item to appear. 

Our order cutoff time is 10am the day before delivery, to give us time to pack.

The ordering window is open for an entire week, so we feel it is fair to not accept any late orders. Our packing process is very specific and they tend to cause mistakes. 

When do you deliver to 'x' location?

Our delivery schedule is currently:

Sundays: Brookfield, Mequon

Mondays: Plymouth, Kiel

Tuesdays: Northwest Milwaukee, South Milwaukee 

Wednesdays: Racine, Kenosha.

Fridays: Madison Area

Please check the Pickup Locations page for specific addresses and hours.  

Our route schedules can occasionally change due to holidays or inclement weather.

We will send an e-mail notice should that ever happen.

FARM BASED. LOW WASTE.

Grassway Organics on-farm store is a natural food store that offers many farm product varieties including, 100% grass-fed beef cuts, pastured chicken, pastured turkey and pork, farm-fresh pastured eggs as well as other items from bulk teas/spices to allergy and gluten-free specialties, along with local product from our surrounding communities.
 

​We encourage helping the environment by providing ways to be eco-friendly. Lower your carbon footprint and save! Bring your own jars and bags for bulk items and receive a percentage off of your purchase.

Thank you for Supporting Local Farms and Local Communities!
